INSERT INTO pre_admission_draft (cycle_id, result_id, assigned_dept_id, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{cycleId}, #{resultId}, #{assignedDeptId}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorId}, NOW(), NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE assigned_dept_id = VALUES(assigned_dept_id), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT pad.* FROM pre_admission_draft pad JOIN interview_result ir ON ir.result_id = pad.result_id WHERE pad.cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND NOT ORDER BY pad.draft_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE interview_result ir JOIN pre_admission_draft pad ON pad.result_id = ir.result_id SET ir.decision = 1, ir.assigned_dept_id = pad.assigned_dept_id, ir.decision_by = #{operatorId}, ir.decision_at = NOW() WHERE pad.cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND ir.decision = 0 AND NOT AND COALESCE(ir.cycle_id, (SELECT isc.cycle_id FROM interview_schedule isc WHERE isc.schedule_id = ir.schedule_id)) = #{cycleId}
